doc.title: Holman Bill — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Back with Kenton and the chart Zoot
summary: He writes a piece for Zoot Sims and Kenton says it sounds like Basie.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You‟re back with Stan. How are things? You took a little break. A change in personnel in the band? How did the band feel when you came back in to it?
Did you get more opportunities to do arranging and contribute to the repertory?

Yeah. I got an opportunity to write a piece for Zoot, which I called Zoot. Come to think of it, Stan did finally start announcing that piece. In his car on his way home from the rehearsal, he – back to the hotel. We were in Cincinnati – he said, “I like the Zoot piece, although it sounds a little like Basie to me.” I recognized that word. “I had to write it for Zoot. That‟s what came out.” He accepted that and played it, but he had to get his criticism in there.
